body: Orchestrator integration note (acceptance round): under `npm run coverage` on a loaded machine the two-sprint test in `src/core/services/attemptsIncrement.test.ts` timed out at 15 s. Commit 7aa7c70 gives that describe block a 60 s timeout (`TWO_SPRINT_TIMEOUT`), matching the convention DM-359 used for real-Git tests.
